clue.text: Strong binding

definitions.meaning: a sturdy, well-built person is called big and burly
a band or strip of material used for tying or fastening

explanation.definitionFit: A strapping lad is robust and muscular; strapping is also the material of straps used to bind things.

clue.text: A girl is the making of the servicemen, some say

indicators.note: some say marks that the phrase is spoken, giving a word with that sound

parts.note: the RAs, the Royal Artillery's gunners, are servicemen

explanation.surface: A woman is supposedly the making of the soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The RAs' (Royal Artillery) spoken quickly gives the name; 'is the making of' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so a girl.

clue.text: A duck kept inside stays fit

indicators.note: the zero is kept inside the supports

parts.note: stays are supports, props
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, O

explanation.surface: A duck held indoors remains in good health.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos means apt or appropriate, fitting the occasion.

clue.text: The writer going around to match a colour

indicators.note: the writing tool goes around the other piece

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
to agree is to correspond or match

explanation.surface: An author travels about looking for a shade that matches.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale yellowish green is named after the pod vegetable.

clue.text: The dealer sounds less refined

indicators.note: sounds signals that the word is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: grosser means coarser, less refined

explanation.surface: A trader comes across as rather coarse.
explanation.definitionFit: A grocer is a shopkeeper who deals in food.

clue.text: Taking action in disorder-a bloomer

indicators.note: the letters are put in disorder, jumbled up

explanation.surface: Taking chaotic action leads to a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' suggests a mistake, but it is a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The tobacco plant flowers, so it is literally something that blooms.

clue.text: A feature of the church, up to a point

definitions.text: A feature of the church, up to a point

parts.words: A feature of the church, up to a point
parts.note: reads as partly a church feature, but means a church structure rising to a sharp tip

explanation.definitionFit: A spire tower rises from a church to a pointed top.

clue.text: The person agitating for an investigator

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a tester is one who examines or investigates

explanation.surface: Someone who stirs up trouble on behalf of a detective.
explanation.definitionFit: A campaigner who demonstrates and agitates against something.

clue.text: Roll round about one to make merry

indicators.note: the list of names goes round about, enclosing the numeral piece

parts.note: a roll is a list of names, a roster
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone rolls about in celebration to have a good time.
explanation.definitionFit: To roister is to revel noisily, carousing in boisterous celebration.

clue.text: Go back and discuss terms again

definitions.meaning: to withdraw or move backwards, as an army does

explanation.definitionFit: An army in retreat withdraws; split as re-treat it means negotiating over again.

clue.text: The least likely to panic when close to failure

definitions.text: The least likely to panic when close to failure

parts.words: The least likely to panic when close to failure
parts.note: describes the calmest person of all at a moment of near disaster, keeping a level head

explanation.definitionFit: Being cool means staying calm and unflustered, so the superlative fits the most composed person under pressure.

clue.text: Consumed by anger-must be restrained!

indicators.note: by here means beside, so one piece is placed next to the other

parts.note: temper is a fit of anger
consumed means ate, as of food

explanation.surface: Someone eaten up with rage is urged to keep themselves in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Temperate means moderate and self-controlled, showing restraint.

clue.text: They require suitable clients

parts.note: reads as needing fit customers, but means people who need customers for suits

explanation.definitionFit: Makers of suits need customers who want clothes made.

clue.text: Objects, it's clear, to change

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are made to change their order into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone protests that something obvious ought to be altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Articles are items or things, as in articles of clothing.

clue.text: Not at one's best because in quiet spot

indicators.note: the word for because goes in, between the two other pieces

parts.note: P is piano, the musical abbreviation for quiet
to spot is to see
as can mean because

explanation.surface: Someone is below par because they are stuck in some quiet place.
explanation.definitionFit: Passée describes someone past their prime, faded and no longer at their peak.

clue.text: Soft over revolutionary at one on victimising others

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the first piece above the next

parts.note: P is piano, soft in music
a red is a revolutionary, a communist
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A gentle radical turns on others.
explanation.definitionFit: Predation is preying on others, as a hunter does on victims.

clue.text: Use no offensive language!

parts.note: an instruction to soften speech, replacing harsh words with milder ones

explanation.definitionFit: To speak in mild substitute terms is to avoid giving offence.

clue.text: The pawnbroker having an odious appearance

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase standing for an adjective describing something foul-looking

parts.note: uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker

explanation.surface: The pawnbroker is said to look thoroughly repellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My uncle' is old British slang for the pawnbroker; 'having' merely joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unclean is dirty and foul, so it presents a repellent look.

clue.text: Seamen at home with the strong drink

parts.note: ABs are able seamen
in means at home

explanation.surface: Sailors at home with hard liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: A potent wormwood-flavoured spirit.

clue.text: Queer it may be, but it's not so noisy

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters could be something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Something odd may be calmer.
explanation.definitionFit: Quieter is the comparative of quiet, meaning less loud.

clue.text: An individual in deep water may make use of the bar

indicators.note: the letters of the words are used again to make a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone in trouble may resort to the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In deep water' suggests trouble, but here it is literal: a swimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer is literally in deep water, perhaps out of their depth.

clue.text: Double-dealer offering characteristic alternative

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A two-faced person offering a distinctive option.
explanation.definitionFit: One who betrays a cause or country is a double-crosser.

clue.text: A fitting place for the viewer

definitions.text: A fitting place for the viewer

parts.words: A fitting place for the viewer
parts.note: reads as a suitable seat for a spectator, but means a socket the eye fits into

explanation.definitionFit: An eye socket or peephole is where the eye goes.

clue.text: The German will accept anything, that's the issue

indicators.note: the German article will accept, taking in, the word for anything

parts.note: der is a German word for the
aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: A German says he will accept anything, and that settles the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring, and a girl child is one of them.

clue.text: A terse eccentric needed a holiday

indicators.note: eccentric means odd, so the letters are oddly rearranged

explanation.surface: A curt oddball needed a break.
explanation.definitionFit: A Christian festival with public holidays in spring.

clue.text: Sounds made by crawlers carrying cross

indicators.note: the snakes are carrying, holding inside them, the word for angry

parts.note: asps are snakes, things that crawl
cross means angry, irate

explanation.surface: Sycophants making noises while bearing a crucifix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crawlers' suggests toadies, but here they are snakes.
explanation.definitionFit: In phonetics, breathed h-sounds are called by this name.

clue.text: Medicos after the right sort of flask

indicators.note: after places the doctors' piece behind the others

parts.note: MOs are medical officers, doctors

explanation.surface: Doctors are looking for the correct kind of container.
explanation.definitionFit: A vacuum flask keeping drinks hot is known by this trade name.

clue.text: Arranged toast in place

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in a different order

explanation.surface: A toast is set up at a venue.
explanation.definitionFit: A station is a position or post, a place where someone is put.

clue.text: Love lyrics written by egghead-mastermind

parts.note: love is nil, O, in tennis
verse is poetry or lyrics
the head of egg is its first letter, E

explanation.surface: Romantic songs composed by an intellectual genius.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives the head of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: To mastermind a project is to direct and supervise it.

clue.text: Prepared to create a scene

parts.note: reads as ready to make a fuss, but means actors who have practised a part of a play

explanation.definitionFit: Actors who have practised a scene beforehand are ready to perform it.
